title: Miss Billy — Married
author: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter
longDescription: Porter is a novel written during the early 20th century. The story revolves around the newly married couple, Billy Neilson and Bertram Henshaw, as they navigate their relationship, family expectations, and the challenges of married life.

authorInfo.bio: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter (1868–1920) is the author of Miss Billy — Married. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
